note: AS-BUILT (0.28.0), four kinds chosen by what the diff introduced. flow = the shipped launch path (Intent.Body as the fold target, the byte preflight + typed CommandTooLongError inside Launch/LaunchPersistent, runTmux's bounded stderr capture into TmuxError, and the exact-match probe forms - note capture-pane needs the PANE form '=name:', not '=name'; the plan's FR1.5 said otherwise and was corrected, see A2). sequence = the plans-tab v/w viewers over the existing openArtifact + pages seams, including the esc return path that must not land on modeDrill. activity = the shipped status-line taxonomy (statusLevel recorded beside m.status, reset per keypress, rendered red/amber/dim plus a marker glyph so the distinction survives a colourless terminal). class = the new/changed types the diff added across launch + tui + cli/plan.go.
